methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Office of Internal Oversight Services (OIOS) publishes internal audit, inspection and evaluation reports plus annual reports at https://oios.un.org/resources/. The site is a server-rendered Drupal application, and OIOS explicitly states all site documents are PDFs.

## Search
A search interface exists (links to /en/search and /en/search_page; a ?s={query} style parameter is referenced). The exact parameter syntax was not fully confirmed from the excerpt, so the search-URL template is a best-effort. Category-based browsing is reliably available.

## Filters
Reports are organized into categories rather than URL-parameter filters: Reports to governing bodies, Annual reports, Evaluation reports, Internal audit reports (e.g. /en/audit-reports, /en/inspection-evaluation-reports).

## Download
Direct PDF. Documents live under /sites/default/files/Reports/ (example: iad_audit_manual_062023.pdf). No authentication required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
No REST API (no /wp-json - it is Drupal, not WordPress). Metadata parsed from link text and filename. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
Server-rendered, so no headless browser is needed for browsing category pages. The search parameter syntax (?s=) is inferred and should be verified against a live query before relying on keyword search; browse + direct download are the solid capabilities.
